description: This class includes the manufacture of special-purpose machinery not elsewhere classified.
includes: manufacture of machinery for making paper and paperboard
manufacture of machinery for processing plastics and rubber: extruders, moulding machines, blow moulding machines
manufacture of machinery for printing and bookbinding
manufacture of machinery for working glass: machines for glass cutting, bending and forming
manufacture of machinery for the manufacture of ceramic products
manufacture of machinery for the manufacture of rope or cable
manufacture of robots for special-purpose use
manufacture of machinery for manufacturing tiles, bricks, shaped cement products
manufacture of machinery for the preparation or making of tobacco products
manufacture of machinery for the production and hot working of glass or glassware
manufacture of machinery for public works, building and civil engineering
manufacture of chassis-mounted specialized equipment for fire-fighting vehicles, snow-removing vehicles, etc.
excludes: manufacture of mining and construction machinery, see 2824
manufacture of food processing machinery, see 2825
